item.title: Riveting Rubidium in Alkali-Metal Layers: High-Performance P2-Type Layered Oxide Cathodes for Potassium-Ion Batteries
item.description:
جایگزینی یون‌های بزرگ Rb+ در سایت‌های منشوری کاتد لایه‌ای P2-type منگنزدار، انتقال فاز P2–P′2 و اعوجاج Jahn–Teller را سرکوب کرده و عملکرد باتری یون-پتاسیم را بهبود می‌دهد.
ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in riveting oversized Rb+ into prismatic alkali-metal sites of P2-type K0.55Mn0.8Ni0.1Ti0.1O2, acting as a rigid pillar that expands interlayer spacing and strengthens TM–O bonds. This suppresses the P2–P′2 transition and Jahn–Teller distortion, enabling fast K+ diffusion, high capacity (105.3 mAh g–1), excellent rate capability, and 82.1% retention over 500 cycles—offering a universal near-zero-strain cathode strategy for potassium-ion batteries.

💡 The novelty lies in using sodium phytate crosslinked PVDF binder to tailor PVDF crystalline phase for Li+ transport and suppress irreversible surface lattice oxygen oxidation in Li-rich Mn-based oxide cathodes. This enables high initial Coulombic efficiency (95%), 322 mAh/g capacity, and ~90% retention after 400 cycles, offering a scalable strategy to stabilize anionic redox interfaces for commercialization.

item.title: Interphase-Controlled Mechanical Confinement of Na Clustering for High-Rate Sodium Storage
item.description:
این کار با اثر محدودسازی مکانیکی کنترل‌شده توسط فصل مشترک، خوشه‌بندی سدیم در حفرات بسته آند کربن سخت را مهار کرده و ذخیره‌سازی سریع سدیم را بهبود می‌دهد.
Energy & Environmental Science | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using interphase-controlled mechanical confinement to suppress slow Na clustering in hard carbon closed pores, addressing the decisive bottleneck for fast-charging sodium storage. Its significance is enabling high-rate sodium storage by tailoring the confining interphase, offering a design principle for fast-charging hard carbon anodes.
🏷 hard carbon anode · sodium storage · Na clustering · solid electrolyte interphase · fast charging
